notes.title: DCL "Father's Story" has been updated.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36088517/508403ec2af7e848c67d81f9071a1bf7c538bc90.jpg
Happy Chinese New Year!
DCL "Father's Story" has been updated.
update content:
1. "Father's Story" DLC has been added.
2. New landing animation - Kane
3. New NPC vertical painting added
4. Added 14 scenes
5. Added CG-21 sheets

Repair content:
1. Fixed the problem that Steam achievements cannot be read.
2. Fixed some typos.
3. Fixed some script translations
4. The archive mode has been modified, and "fact archive" has been implemented.

Thanks again to all players for their waiting and support, I will continue to optimize and improve the game and dedicate more content to everyone! Hope you all support the original version!
At the same time, please pay attention to the two new games this year
1. "Office Uncle"
2. "Star Wish Traveler"

If you find a wrong translation in the game, you can leave a message in the steam forum! Or send me an email.

notes.title: BUG FIXED!
notes.content:
Fixed a bug from player feedback!
If your game still goes to a black screen when you enter the main story, it can't be ruled out that there is a problem with your computer system. Since players with the same system, they are not experiencing this, maybe your antivirus software deleted something?

notes.title: About the "BUG" that appear in the game
notes.content:
1.We're fixing an issue with the game!
2.Regarding the English translation, we will slowly make changes later.
3.We have fixed the issue of "the game can't continue to run" or "the screen is black and can't be run", we will update it later!
4.An issue regarding some minigames not continuing to run has been fixed. It will be updated later.


Just my first indie game! The game can be buggy, but I'll try to fix it as soon as I can! Thank you for your support!
